pages.text: {{hero}} has a pet dinosaur. It is big and red. {{hero}} and the big pet nap in the sun. It is fun!
{{hero}} can see an egg in the mud. It is big! {{hero}} and the pet dig and dig to get it.
But the egg is in a pit. {{hero}} can not get it up! {{hero}} and the pet tug and tug. It is not fun.
The big pet hops in the pit. {{hero}} sets the egg on top of the pet. Up, up, up! {{hero}} and the pet did it!
The sun is set. {{hero}} and the pet sit in a den. The egg is in a big hat. But tap, tap, tap! What is in the egg?
